title: 地球结构与语境词义
text: In Earth science, crust is the outer solid layer, mantle is the layer below the crust, and core is the central region. Lithosphere includes the crust and the rigid uppermost mantle. In this context, core means 地核, and mantle means 地幔. A fictional expedition should not imply that humans can walk into Earth's core.
source: 项目自编学习笔记，未经外部教材审核

title: 经纬度与定位
text: Latitude describes position north or south of the equator; longitude describes position east or west of the prime meridian. Both are used together to identify a location. Latitude means 纬度 and longitude means 经度.
source: 项目自编学习笔记，未经外部教材审核

title: 气体词汇的语境
text: Oxygen, hydrogen and carbon dioxide are different substances. Oxide describes a compound of oxygen with another element. Do not treat hydrogen as breathable oxygen. A fictional laboratory story should avoid giving chemical experiment instructions.
source: 项目自编学习笔记，未经外部教材审核
